judul: Bijak Konsumsi Pangan Kurangi Food Waste
catatan:
Agenda 4 - Ekonomi Sirkular | 6 slide Story IG

SLIDE 1 - HOOK
Prompt: Flat illustration, overhead view of a kitchen trash bin overflowing with fresh vegetables, fruit, and packaged food. Warm yellow-orange background. Style: modern Indonesian editorial illustration, clean lines, slightly melancholic mood. 9:16 vertical format.
Copy: Headline: Beli banyak, mubazir banyak. | Subtext: Setiap hari, lebih banyak makanan terbuang dari yang kita sadari. | Bottom tag: Kamu bagian dari solusi?

SLIDE 2 - FAKTA LOKAL
Prompt: Flat illustration, Papuan coastal market scene. A Papuan woman vendor selling fresh fish, tropical vegetables, and papaya on a wooden table. Some produce visibly wilting on the side. Warm teal and green palette. 9:16 vertical format.
Copy: Headline: Di Papua, pangan segar mudah didapat. | Subtext: Tapi juga mudah rusak kalau salah simpan. | Warning tag: Makanan rusak = tidak aman + terbuang sia-sia.

SLIDE 3 - TIPS PRAKTIS
Prompt: Flat illustration, triptych layout 3 stacked panels: top panel shows a shopping basket with only essential items; middle panel shows hands wrapping vegetables and placing fish in freezer container; bottom panel shows food containers arranged by date FIFO. Clean white background, green and blue accents. 9:16 vertical format.
Copy: Panel 1: Beli sesuai kebutuhan | Panel 2: Simpan dengan benar - freezer dalam 2 jam | Panel 3: FIFO - yang duluan masuk, duluan dipakai

SLIDE 4 - KEAMANAN PANGAN
Prompt: Flat illustration, split composition: left side shows properly stored food in sealed containers bright and fresh; right side shows improperly stored food with visible bacteria icons floating around it muted warning red. Subtle dividing line. Clean minimal background. 9:16 vertical format.
Copy: Headline: Salah simpan bukan cuma bikin mubazir. | Left label: Aman dan segar | Right label: Bakteri berkembang | Bottom: Bijak konsumsi = hemat + tetap aman.

SLIDE 5 - CTA UTAMA
Prompt: Flat illustration, Papuan family of three mother father young child sitting around a dinner table with modest but complete meal, smiling. Simple Papuan home interior, natural wood elements. Warm green and cream palette. Hopeful mood. 9:16 vertical format.
Copy: Main text: Mulai dari dapur kita, mulai dari Papua. | Tagline: Konsumsi cerdas. Pangan aman. Lingkungan terjaga. | Bottom: BPOM Mobile - Cek izin edar sebelum beli | #BijakKonsumsi #PanganAman #BBPOMJayapura

SLIDE 6 - SURVEY CTA
Prompt: Flat illustration, Papuan young woman sitting casually holding a smartphone, smiling and tapping the screen. Speech bubble with star rating symbol floating nearby. Small cenderawasih bird silhouette in top corner. Warm cream and green background consistent with previous slides. Space at bottom for QR code. 9:16 vertical format.
Copy: Headline: Konten ini bermanfaat buat kamu? | Subtext: Bantu kami bikin edukasi yang makin relevan untuk masyarakat Papua. | CTA: Isi survei - 2 menit aja | Bottom: QR code placeholder + atau tap link di bio
